tei:div.tei:p: khams kyi bla chen la gdams pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi khrid tshigs bcad ma bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru/ yul med kyi shes pa rjen pa 'di// 'khor 'das kyi bde la longs spyod cing*// snang stong gi chos la dbang bsgyur ba// rje longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhabs la 'dud// sems rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs// bu skal pa ma chad lha chos dran// rigs mtho mdo khams dbus su skyes// gnas gnyan po 'bri gung 'og min du// rje klu rigs sgrol ma'i rnam 'phrul can// yab 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs la gtugs// dar ser po gcig gi rten 'brel gyis// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar byas// dus de nas bzung ste da lta'i bar// mos gus la ltem rkyang ma shor bas// rje mnyam med rin chen rgyal po dang*/ kho bo dpon slob dag dang mjal// rje rin chen byin rlabs chu rgyun zhugs// bdag gi ༄༅/ /rin chen bum pa gang*// dgongs pa gcig pa'i tshul nyid du/ khyed dpon drung snying la rab zhugs pas// dad dang mos pa'i sa gzhi la// yid ches kyi lo thog bskrun pas na// lhun grub kyi 'bras bu rtogs pa skyes// rtogs 'bul gyi rim pa du ma dang*// ngo sprod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gnyis dag /dad pas gso phyir dgos zhes pa// yang nas yang du skul ba'i ngor// snying nas gces par 'di skad brjod// bu skal ldan sgom gyi gdungs pa khyod// sgom phyi ru ma tshol nang du ltos// sems bzhag pas mi sdod yan du chug /bzung bas mi zin glod la zhog /sgom 'dod na sgom min gyi snang ba de 'u ge skyongs// gzhi yi blo la blo yis mi bsgoms par// rang babs la bzo yis ma bcos par// blo rtog pa la skyon du mi lta bar// mi rtog pa phyed du mi bsgrubs par// sems rang sor zhog la rig pa'i rgyang so zhig tshugs dang*// sgom rtse gcig gi steng du phebs nas 'ong*// de la gol sa'i 'phrang zhig yod// rtse gcig khyim na mun pas sgrib// zhes pa'i gnas lugs sgrol ba la// rtse gcig gnas la ma zhen par// thag chod gdengs thob kyi 'phrang sgrol gces// ma yengs pa'i dran pa gcig ma shor na// mi sgom pa'i gnas lugs la bzo mi bya// rang gsal gyi rig pa de smra mi 'dod// rtog dpyod kyi ma slad kha yan du skyongs dang*// sgom spros bral gyi steng du phebs nas 'ong*// de la gol sa'i 'phrang zhig yod// spros bral stong rdzi'i lhag pas thebs// ces pa'i gnas lugs sgrol ba la// stong lta had por ma shor bar// thag chod dang rgyu 'bras kyi 'phrang sgrol gces// sems ngos bzung med pa stong pa'i dbyings// blo bral gyi gsal stong rjen pa 'di// rang sor zhog la rang ngo ltos// sgom ro gcig gi steng du phebs nas 'ong*// de la gol sa'i 'phrang zhig yod// ro gcig rgya mtsho'i rba la g.yengs// zhes pa'i gnas lugs sgrol ba la// de la zhen cing ma chags par// du mar 'char ba'i 'phrang sgrol gces// blo rtog pa sgyu ma'i gnas lugs sgoms// rang ngo shes pa de nyams len gnad// rang zhal mjal ba de rang grol yin// sgom yul thog tu 'char ba de 'gag med yin// yul 'dzin rkyen las skyes pa de skye med kyi gshis// rang shar dang rang grol de brjod dang bral// sgom med kyi steng du phebs nas 'ong*// de la gol sa'i 'phrang zhig yod// sgom med nyi ma sprin gyis bsgribs// zhes pa'i gnas lugs sgrol ba la// de la mngon zhen spangs nas su// mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi 'phrang sgrol gces// stong nyid rgyu 'bras rten 'brel dang*// stobs bcu'i 'byung gnas kyi tshul khrims kyi// sdom gsum thar pa'i srog shing dang*// nyams chags med par bsrung bar zhu// byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed kyi// smon 'jug don dam bsam pa dang*// med na mi 'byung gi lhag bsam de// 'gro ba'i don du bskyed par mdzod// tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi smin byed lam// gsang sngags rgyal po grol lam gyi// phyi rol lha dang gzhal yas khang*// tha mal sa rdor mi 'dzin zhu// rgyu bar ma do ru ma lus par// gdod nas yod dang byas bsags kyi// dge ba bgyis dang bgyid bstsal ba// 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bsngos// zhes pa 'di nyid bsod nams dang ye shes kyi mngon par mtho zhing*/

rigs dang yon tan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ lung dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag khams skyo bla chen kun spangs kun dga' rgyal po sku mched kyis dgos zhes gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis tshigs su bcad pa myong thog nas bris pa nyid/ 'bri gung spyan snga ā nanda ratna shrī bha dras gdan sa chen po 'bri gung 'og min byang chub gling du sbyar ba'o/// /
